# API Endpoints Quick Reference

**Last Updated:** 2026-01-06
**Total Endpoints:** 46

This document provides a quick reference to all API endpoints in Nanobanna Pro. For detailed documentation, see [ENDPOINTS_CATALOG.md](./ENDPOINTS_CATALOG.md) and [SCHEMAS.md](./SCHEMAS.md).

---

## Table of Contents

1. [AI Routes (13 endpoints)](#ai-routes)
2. [Authentication Routes (6 endpoints)](#authentication-routes)
3. [Chat Routes (5 endpoints)](#chat-routes)
4. [Image Management Routes (2 endpoints)](#image-management-routes)
5. [Replicate Proxy Routes (2 endpoints)](#replicate-proxy-routes)
6. [Storage Routes (11 endpoints)](#storage-routes)
7. [User Routes (7 endpoints)](#user-routes)

## AI Routes

**Base Path:** `/api/ai`
**Authentication:** Required (all endpoints)
**Rate Limit:** 30 requests/minute

| Method | Endpoint | Purpose | Details |
|--------|----------|---------|---------|
| `POST` | `/api/ai/chat` | Chat completions with tool calling | [Catalog](./ENDPOINTS_CATALOG.md#1-post-apiaichat) \| [Schema](./SCHEMAS.md#1-post-apiaichat) |
| `POST` | `/api/ai/image/generate` | Generate images using Replicate models | [Catalog](./ENDPOINTS_CATALOG.md#2-post-apiaiimagegenerate) \| [Schema](./SCHEMAS.md#2-post-apiaiimagegenerate) |
| `POST` | `/api/ai/image/edit` | Instruction-based image editing | [Catalog](./ENDPOINTS_CATALOG.md#3-post-apiaiimageedit) \| [Schema](./SCHEMAS.md#3-post-apiaiimageedit) |
| `POST` | `/api/ai/image/remove-bg` | Remove background from images | [Catalog](./ENDPOINTS_CATALOG.md#4-post-apiaiimageremove-bg) \| [Schema](./SCHEMAS.md#4-post-apiaiimageremove-bg) |
| `POST` | `/api/ai/image/upscale` | Upscale images 4x using AI | [Catalog](./ENDPOINTS_CATALOG.md#5-post-apiaiimageupscale) \| [Schema](./SCHEMAS.md#5-post-apiaiimageupscale) |
| `POST` | `/api/ai/image/outpaint` | Extend images beyond original bounds | [Catalog](./ENDPOINTS_CATALOG.md#6-post-apiaiimageoutpaint) \| [Schema](./SCHEMAS.md#6-post-apiaiimageoutpaint) |
| `POST` | `/api/ai/image/restore` | Restore old/damaged images | [Catalog](./ENDPOINTS_CATALOG.md#7-post-apiaiimagerestore) \| [Schema](./SCHEMAS.md#7-post-apiaiimagerestore) |
| `POST` | `/api/ai/prompt/enhance` | Enhance prompts with context | [Catalog](./ENDPOINTS_CATALOG.md#8-post-apiaipromptenhance) \| [Schema](./SCHEMAS.md#8-post-apiaipromptenhance) |
| `POST` | `/api/ai/image/generate-simple` | Simplified image generation | [Catalog](./ENDPOINTS_CATALOG.md#9-post-apiaiimagegenerate-simple) \| [Schema](./SCHEMAS.md#9-post-apiaiimagegenerate-simple) |
| `POST` | `/api/ai/image/restyle` | Restyle images with new style | [Catalog](./ENDPOINTS_CATALOG.md#10-post-apiaiimagerestyle) \| [Schema](./SCHEMAS.md#10-post-apiaiimagerestyle) |
| `POST` | `/api/ai/suggestions/prompt` | Get prompt suggestions | [Catalog](./ENDPOINTS_CATALOG.md#11-post-aisuggestionsprompt) \| [Schema](./SCHEMAS.md#11-post-aisuggestionsprompt) |
| `POST` | `/api/ai/suggestions/industry` | Get industry-specific suggestions | [Catalog](./ENDPOINTS_CATALOG.md#12-post-aisuggestionsindutry) \| [Schema](./SCHEMAS.md#12-post-aisuggestionsindutry) |
| `GET` | `/api/ai/models` | List available AI models | [Catalog](./ENDPOINTS_CATALOG.md#13-get-apiaimodels) \| [Schema](./SCHEMAS.md#13-get-apiaimodels) |

## Authentication Routes

**Base Path:** `/api/auth`
**Authentication:** Not required (public endpoints)
**Rate Limits:** Varies by endpoint

| Method | Endpoint | Purpose | Rate Limit | Details |
|--------|----------|---------|------------|---------|
| `POST` | `/api/auth/signup` | Register new user | 3/min | [Catalog](./ENDPOINTS_CATALOG.md#1-post-apiauthsignup) \| [Schema](./SCHEMAS.md#1-post-apiauthsignup) |
| `POST` | `/api/auth/login` | Authenticate user | 5/min | [Catalog](./ENDPOINTS_CATALOG.md#2-post-apiauthlogin) \| [Schema](./SCHEMAS.md#2-post-apiauthlogin) |
| `POST` | `/api/auth/logout` | End session | None | [Catalog](./ENDPOINTS_CATALOG.md#3-post-apiauthlogout) \| [Schema](./SCHEMAS.md#3-post-apiauthlogout) |
| `GET` | `/api/auth/session` | Get current session | None | [Catalog](./ENDPOINTS_CATALOG.md#4-get-apiauthsession) \| [Schema](./SCHEMAS.md#4-get-apiauthsession) |
| `POST` | `/api/auth/forgot-password` | Request password reset | 3/min | [Catalog](./ENDPOINTS_CATALOG.md#5-post-apiauthforgot-password) \| [Schema](./SCHEMAS.md#5-post-apiauthforgot-password) |
| `POST` | `/api/auth/reset-password` | Reset password with token | 5/min | [Catalog](./ENDPOINTS_CATALOG.md#6-post-apiauthreset-password) \| [Schema](./SCHEMAS.md#6-post-apiauthreset-password) |

## Quick Filters

### By Authentication Status

**Public Endpoints (6):**
- All `/api/auth/*` endpoints

**Authenticated Endpoints (40):**
- All other endpoints

### By HTTP Method

**GET (15 endpoints):**
- Session, models, lists, profile data

**POST (21 endpoints):**
- AI operations, authentication, create operations

**PUT (5 endpoints):**
- Update operations (designs, profiles, API keys)

**DELETE (5 endpoints):**
- Delete operations (designs, images, chat, account)

### By Rate Limit

**Rate Limited (7 endpoints):**
- All `/api/ai/*` (30/min)
- `/api/auth/signup` (3/min)
- `/api/auth/login` (5/min)
- `/api/auth/forgot-password` (3/min)
- `/api/auth/reset-password` (5/min)

**No Rate Limit (39 endpoints):**
- Storage, user, chat, image management endpoints

---

## Common Patterns

### Pagination

Endpoints that return lists support optional pagination:

```typescript
GET /api/images?limit=20&offset=0
GET /api/storage/designs?limit=10&offset=10
```

### Filtering

Some endpoints support filtering by date or status:

```typescript
GET /api/chat?since=2026-01-01
GET /api/user/usage?period=month
```

### Sorting

List endpoints default to newest first:

```typescript
GET /api/storage/designs  // Sorted by created_at DESC
```

---

## Response Formats

### Success Response (200/201)

```typescript
{
  // Endpoint-specific data
  "url": "https://...",
  "id": "123",
  "data": {...}
}
```

### Error Response (4xx/5xx)

```typescript
{
  "error": "Human-readable error message"
}
```

### Rate Limit Response (429)

```typescript
{
  "error": "Too many requests. Please try again later."
}
```

**Headers:**
```
Retry-After: 60
```

task_intent.title: 024-document-backend-api-routes-and-request-response-s
task_intent.description: The frontend makes calls to /api/ai/* endpoints (chat, image/generate, image/edit, image/upscale, prompt/enhance, etc.) through api.ts, but there's no documentation of the expected request payloads, response formats, error codes, or rate limiting behavior. Developers must trace code or guess API contracts.
